description: Read forward sampled pool states or perpetual midpoints, including quiet/unavailable states and separate definition versions. These are sampled quotes rather than trades or cash-security OHLC. Requires exact market, symbol and UTC from/to timestamps, maximum 31 days. No history is inferred before collection began.

from.description: Window start, UTC timestamp ending in Z (e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

symbol.description: Exact, case-sensitive symbol from get_onchain_quotes catalog=true (e.g. PAXG, xyz:SILVER).

to.description: Window end, UTC timestamp ending in Z; at most 31 days after from.

name: get_market_history
